descriptionPlain: Acme is looking for a product designer to own our China market surfaces. You will work with a small, senior team shipping weekly.

lists.content: <ul><li>Portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product thinking</li><li>Fluency in Figma and design systems</li><li>Business-level English and native Mandarin</li></ul>
<p>Competitive salary, equity, and 15 days of annual leave.</p>
